name: admin.conversations.restrictAccess.removeGroup
purpose: Remove a linked IDP group linked from a private channel

team_id.desc: The workspace where the channel exists. This argument is required for channels only tied to one workspace, and optional for channels that are shared across an organization.

group_id.desc: The IDP Group ID to remove from the private channel.

channel_id.desc: The channel to remove the linked group from.
